items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: The classical Segovia style uses the thumb and three more fingers in the high string.

ctx.x: Index and thumb, yeah. Now, we used to hear them in Amit. That's the place where McKay had a, his folks had a plantation up there. And they were still all over the place. They were getting few, but many of them we heard were there.
The classical Segovia style uses the thumb and three more fingers in the high string. But you all didn't do that.
Well, what ruined my playing was those three lessons I had with that woman.
